subject: Now accepting credit card payments
text:
Dear Customer,

Brightline Office Supply Inc now accepts Visa, Mastercard and American Express for invoice payments through our customer portal, in addition to ACH and check. A 2.5% convenience fee applies to card payments.

This is optional. If you prefer to continue paying by ACH, no action is required and your current remittance instructions remain valid.

Brightline Office Supply Inc
label: ordinary
note: Vendor announcing an optional additional payment method; existing instructions unchanged and no action requested.
